overview: Deterministic E2E validation for L1 run-scoped chat: run picker defaults, streaming UX, strict anchor-gated sources, scope mismatch disclosure, and no-context guard.
goals: Keep chat scope explicit and trustworthy.
Ensure source chips obey strict anchor gating.
Prevent dead-end chat interactions when no context exists.
nonGoals: L2/L3 scope modes and compare/merge UX.
successMetrics: Run picker defaults to latest completed run.
Scope mismatch is disclosed whenever selected/effective differ.
No-context mode blocks sending and provides guidance.
uiNotes: Run picker should show recent completed runs.
Streaming state must be explicit while tokens arrive.
Source chips clickable only when anchor-ready; otherwise disabled with reason.

importFormat.description: Scenario uses a folder with completed runs and an additional no-context fixture path.

rules: Selected/effective scope mismatch must always be disclosed.
Anchor-unready sources cannot be clickable evidence links.

stories.title: Ask Within L1 Run Scope with Trustworthy Sources
stories.description: As an operator, I need run-scoped chat to expose scope and source certainty so I can trust each answer.
acceptanceCriteria: Given completed runs exist, chat defaults to the latest completed run in picker.
When sending a question, UI shows streaming state and then response with source chips.
Then source chips are anchor-gated and scope mismatch disclosure appears when selected/effective diverge.
Example: stale selected run causes mismatch warning with selected/effective identifiers.
Negative: when no indexed context exists, composer is disabled and request is not sent.
